paite: Huan naupang Samuel in Eli ma ah TOUPA nna asem hi. Huai lai in TOUPA thu tung avang mahmah a; alangtang a kilaknate a-om kei hi.
heading: Samuel Kiang Ah TOUPA Kilak
english: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in, Eli amun a alup lai in, amit amial panta a, khua agina muhthei nawn ngel kei hi.
english: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

paite: Pathian khawnvak amih ma in, Pathian bawm omna TOUPA tempul ah Samuel ihmu ding in alumta hi.
english: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,

paite: "TOUPA'N Samuel asam a," ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Eli kiang ah ava tai a, akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a,” achi hi. Ama'n, "K'on sam kei; va lum nawn in," achi hi. Huchi in apai a, ava lum nawn hi.
english: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel asam nawn hi. Samuel athou a, Eli kiang ah ahoh a, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a,” achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "K'on sam kei, ka tapa, va lum nawn in,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”

paite: Huai lai in Samuel in TOUPA athei nai kei a, TOUPA thu leng akiang a kilaksak ahi nai kei hi.
english: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel asam nawn a, huai athumveina ahita. Amah athou a, Eli kiang ah ahoh a, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a," achi hi. Huchi in Eli in naupang TOUPA'N sam ahi chih atheita hi.
english: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

paite: Huaiziak in Eli in Samuel kiang ah, "Pai inla, va lum nawn inla, ahon sap nawnleh, TOUPA, thu gen in, na sikha in angaikhia, na chi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel apaita a, amun ah ava lum nawn hi.
english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

paite: TOUPA ahong pai a, hong dingh in, ama a asap bang in, "Samuel, Samuel," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in, "Thu gen in, na sikha in angaikhia hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel gam ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih a aphuaitak in thil khat ka hih ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

paite: Huai ni in a-inkuan tungtang thu ka gen tengteng abul a pan atawp tan in Eli tung ah ka hih ding ahi.
english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

paite: Atapate'n Pathian agensiatna khelhna uh theigige napi a, akham louh ziak in a-inkuan tangtawn a ding in ka hawmsak ding hi, chih ka hilh khinta ngal a.
english: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.

paite: Huaiziak in Eli inkuan kiang ah Eli inkuan bohsiatna kithoihna in hiam, thillat in hiam, chikchiang in leng siansak theih ahi kei ding, chi in ka kichiam khinta hi," achi hi.
english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”

paite: Zingsang tan in Samuel alum a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte ahong hi. Samuel in huai kilakna Eli theihsak alau hi.
english: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.

paite: Huchi in Eli in Samuel asam a, "Samuel, ka tapa," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bang thil ahia TOUPA'N na kiang a agen? Ka kiang ah bangmah iim ke'n aw. Na kiang a agen tengteng ka kiang a iim na neihleh na tung ah Pathian in ahihhih in hih henla, huai sang a thupizaw in leng," achi hi.
english: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”

paite: Samuel in thil tengteng ahilh sipsip a, akiang ah bangmah iim anei kei. Huchi in ama'n, "TOUPA thuthu ahi mah ve, hoih asak bang in hih hen aw," achi hi.
english: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”

paite: Samuel ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om a, athu himhim lei lak ah akesak kei hi.
english: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

paite: Huchi in Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in Israel mi tengteng in TOUPA zawlnei dia Samuel hihkip ahi, chih ana theita uhi.
english: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.

paite: Shiloh ah TOUPA akilak nawn a; TOUPA thu in Samuel kiang ah Shiloh a kilak lah ahi ngal a.
english: Yahweh appeared again in Shiloh; for Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by Yahweh’s word.
